Mohammad Sameer builds production-oriented Generative AI applications and AI/ML workflows. His work focuses on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM applications, FastAPI backends, cloud infrastructure, evaluation-minded product workflows, and practical interfaces that keep people in control.
